clue.text: Judge and attorney bringing in 7 new voting processes

indicators.note: the judge-and-attorney pair takes the next pieces into its middle

parts.note: REF is short for referee, one who judges a game
DA is a district attorney
the answer to 7-down, a word meaning before

explanation.surface: A judge and a lawyer introduce fresh election procedures.
explanation.walkthrough: A bare number in a clue stands for the answer to that numbered clue, here 7-down.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of referendum: public votes put directly to the electorate.

clue.text: Brazilian cash securing good portable organ

indicators.note: the currency word holds the other letter fast inside it

parts.note: the real is the currency of Brazil

explanation.surface: Brazilian money is used to buy a small carryable organ.
explanation.definitionFit: A small portable reed organ of the 16th and 17th centuries bore this name.

clue.text: Partiality to fur Mavis and I developed

indicators.note: the letters have been worked up into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone shows bias in favour of Mavis's fur and their own.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfair preference shown to some over others is the same thing as bias.

clue.text: Farmer moved quickly and caught most of cattle, say

parts.note: to move quickly is to run, past tense ran
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: the last letter is dropped, leaving most of the word

parts.note: cattle are an example of a herd

explanation.surface: A farmer hurries and captures most of his cows.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who owns or runs a large livestock farm is a farmer by trade.

clue.text: I invested in new eastern perfume, having little knowledge

indicators.note: to be invested in something is to be clothed in it, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: a perfume is a scent

explanation.surface: Someone who has put money into a new oriental fragrance, without knowing much about it.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary adjective for ignorance, from Latin nescire, not to know.

clue.text: Leisurely pedestrian's warning about lake

indicators.note: the warning word goes around the other letter

parts.note: amber is the warning light on a traffic signal

explanation.surface: A slow walker gives a warning about a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: One who ambles walks at an easy, unhurried pace.

clue.text: High-pitched sound initially bewildering retired PM

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the next word is used
retiring means going back, so the name is read in reverse

parts.note: Robert Peel was a British prime minister

explanation.surface: A shrill noise first confuses a former prime minister.
explanation.definitionFit: A short electronic beep, high in tone, as from a pager.

clue.text: Scope of old railway publicity in the wild?

parts.note: BR is British Rail, the former national rail operator

indicators.note: the publicity letters sit inside the scrambled word
wild letters are disordered, so this word is rearranged

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity

explanation.surface: A question about how far old rail advertising reached into the wilderness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' turns THE into ETH, which holds AD; BR, for British Rail, comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Breadth is range or extent, as in the breadth of one's interests.

clue.text: Before melody is heard

indicators.note: the word for the tune is spoken, giving a word said the same way

parts.note: an air is a melody

explanation.surface: A tune is heard first.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic or poetic preposition meaning prior to.

clue.text: One goes to court, clear over disagreement

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first piece sits over the second

parts.note: plain means clear, obvious
a tiff is a minor quarrel

explanation.surface: A litigant is clearly cross about a dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: The party who brings a lawsuit against another is the one taking the case to court.

clue.text: Designated army commander capturing four of the Romans

indicators.note: the officer takes the numeral prisoner inside himself

parts.note: GEN is short for general
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A general is named as the one who seized four Romans.
explanation.definitionFit: Something given is specified or fixed, as in a given time.

clue.text: Edit information returned about key taxonomic groups

parts.note: to sub is to subedit, edit copy
gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: turned back, so the short word for about is read backwards

parts.note: re means about, concerning
A is a musical key

explanation.surface: An editor sends back data about a key point in classification.
explanation.definitionFit: Biological ranks between genus and species, each a subdivision of a genus.

clue.text: Roughing up a dull hiker again, guffaw raucously

indicators.note: roughing something up knocks it about, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone beats up a boring walker for a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: A British idiom for a loud, coarse, gurgling laugh.

clue.text: Chap receiving male faculty head like Greek mathematician

indicators.note: the name takes the single letter into itself

parts.note: Archie is a man's name, any chap
a dean heads a university faculty

explanation.surface: A man takes on a male faculty head who resembles an ancient Greek scholar.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective for things pertaining to Archimedes, as in his screw or principle.

clue.text: Dramatic scam blocked by one with rights

indicators.note: the scam word is obstructed by letters lodged inside it

parts.note: a sting is a confidence trick
I is the Roman numeral one
R is short for right, so two of them give RR

explanation.surface: A dramatic fraud is thwarted by someone exercising their rights.
explanation.definitionFit: Exciting and rousing, as in a stirring performance.

clue.text: Like the Ancient Mariner, say, burning to embrace a female?

indicators.note: the burning word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: searing means scorching, burning

explanation.surface: A question about Coleridge's sailor, ablaze with desire to hug a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Coleridge's Ancient Mariner is an example of someone whose life is spent at sea.

clue.text: Pretentiousness overseas character repeatedly displayed

indicators.note: the letter name appears twice in a row

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet, a foreign character

explanation.surface: A foreign figure is shown over and over in a showy way.
explanation.definitionFit: Affected, fussy refinement; as a noun it means showy elegance.

clue.text: Part of chicken new bishop mostly cooked?

indicators.note: cooking up letters means rearranging them
most of the word is used, with its last letter dropped

explanation.surface: A newly appointed bishop is largely cooked, as if he were a chicken.
explanation.definitionFit: The forked bone between the neck and breast of a bird, pulled apart for a wish.

clue.text: Where birds may be accessed at first, using public transport?

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word is taken

parts.note: via means by way of, using
RY is short for railway

explanation.surface: A place for birds reached by bus or train.
explanation.definitionFit: A large enclosure in which birds are kept.

clue.text: Songbird reportedly studied perch

indicators.note: the pair of words is spoken, sounding like the answer

parts.note: studied is read, said like red; a perch is a pole

explanation.surface: A singing bird, so it is said, examined its resting place.
explanation.definitionFit: A small finch with a red forehead, found in northern Europe and America.

clue.text: Skulduggery of person heading military intelligence?

parts.note: possession, of someone, is shown by an apostrophe S
a chief is the person heading an organisation

explanation.surface: A question about underhand deeds by the head of spies.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as MI'S CHIEF, the head of Military Intelligence, who might well be up to skulduggery.
explanation.definitionFit: Playful or harmful troublemaking; skulduggery is underhand trickery.

clue.text: Curved sword usually triangular originally in form?

indicators.note: the picked letters are placed inside the school group word

parts.note: a form is a school class

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so the first letters of the two words

explanation.surface: A question whether a curved blade usually began as a triangle.
explanation.definitionFit: A short, broad, slightly curved sword once used by sailors.

clue.text: Eg King Edward's area adopted by slow-climbing primate

indicators.note: the primate takes the letter in as its own

parts.note: a potto is a slow-moving African primate

explanation.surface: A king's domain is taken over by a sluggish ape.
explanation.walkthrough: King Edward is a well-known British variety of potato, not a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: King Edward is an example, a popular floury variety of this vegetable.

clue.text: Generously equipped, like those prepared to bite back?

definitions.text: like those prepared to bite back?
definitions.meaning: jokingly, ready to retaliate with one's teeth as weapons

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for being heavily armed, which read literally means having weapons right up to one's teeth.

clue.text: Prevaricate, husband having upper hand

parts.note: to have the edge is to have the upper hand

explanation.surface: A husband avoids a straight answer while holding the advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid committing oneself, giving evasive answers.

clue.text: He loves books a Black Sea state briefly rejected

indicators.note: thrown back, so the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of books

indicators.note: cut short, losing the final letter

parts.note: Romania is a country on the Black Sea

explanation.surface: A lover of books is turned away by a Black Sea country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' trims ROMANIA to ROMANI; 'rejected' reverses OT + A + ROMANI to give INAMOR + A + TO.
explanation.definitionFit: A male lover, from Italian; the word refers to a man who is in love.

clue.text: Thickening agent chefs finally abandoned in the past

indicators.note: the chosen letter is left out of the starch word

parts.note: sago is a starch used to thicken food

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Cooks long ago gave up using a thickener.
explanation.definitionFit: Earlier than now, as in years before; an adverb of past time.

clue.text: Improve, with this person intervening

indicators.note: the self-reference comes between the letters of the joining word

parts.note: and means with, together with
the speaker refers to self as me

explanation.surface: Things get better when I step in.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend a text or law is to correct or better it.

clue.text: Malevolent spirit of bird endlessly circling house

indicators.note: the shortened bird surrounds the house letters
without its end, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a gull is a seabird

explanation.surface: An evil spirit in the form of a bird keeps flying around a house.
explanation.definitionFit: An evil being in folklore that robs graves and feeds on corpses.

clue.text: Recipient of honour is cool about knight's submissive gesture

parts.note: an OBE is an Officer of the Order of the British Empire, a person honoured

indicators.note: the cool word goes around the chess letter

parts.note: ace is slang for cool, excellent
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A newly honoured person thinks a knight's bow is cool.
explanation.definitionFit: A deferential bow or curtsy, a gesture showing respect.
